evidence_scope: Source/WASM inspection and independent native-Godot local before/after. No execution of original physics module or whole original matching battle claimed.

rules.physical_registration: battle_systems._physics_process iterates registered alive_list, gathers dead after each state/fire visit, then tick_velocity and repulsion, then _sys_death. WASM117/119/120 use alive-list cache161832; no cached health161796 read in those inspected physics functions.
rules.lethal_impulse: _deliver_charge_hit writes knockback after take_damage without a target-health gate. Local knock now accepts the still-registered lethal victim.
rules.corpse: _sys_death builds ragdoll at current ground pos, facing and normal velocity after integration/repulsion; gets last attacker only if its registration still exists. Deaths release slots sequentially.
rules.late_death: A hit after victim visit (including existing projectile after unit systems) leaves registration until next visit. Drawing remains until actual death collection; new-target search still excludes zeroHP.
rules.elimination: Original battle_manager polls remaining scene-group nodes, not zeroHP. Local elimination is now gated on pending death registrations; original polling cadence/grace and presentation delay remain different.

local_changes: HP0 registered rows integrate and repel through actual death pass.
Corpse record created once at registration release, with true physical foot/facing/velocity/last-attacker.
Dead-unit status timers still expire so project stun/petrification cannot deadlock collection.
Live drawing depends on registration; combat targeting still depends on positiveHP.
Legacy nonpersonal row art keeps its display offset; individual bodies use physical positions.
